digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — Claude Code transcript backfill
propositions: An optional, isolated adapter must mine local Claude Code transcript JSONL to extract environment and integration diagnosis signals via deterministic error-signature pattern matching (no LLM calls or network).

The adapter must classify candidate transcript lines into exactly five categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using first-match keyword/regex routing; every emitted record must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to label it as low-confidence backfill data.
The core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must NOT import the Claude transcript adapter, enforcing portability and ensuring the command functions independently of the backfill harness.

The backfill script (scripts/backfill_transcripts.py) must be tested end-to-end to verify it extracts and classifies fixture transcript records with the correct labeled schema and does not invoke any LLM or network service.
